chosen.alternative_lora: SedatAl/pixel-art-LoRa (also SD 1.5, fine-tuned on the diffusiondb-pixelart dataset; licence likewise not stated in the fetched card)
chosen.base_model_license_reported: CreativeML OpenRAIL-M (reported for the original checkpoint and its mirrors in search results; verify the LICENSE file in the downloaded repo before any commercial use)
chosen.base_model_note: Community mirror of the original runwayml/stable-diffusion-v1-5. The original RunwayML Hugging Face organisation was deleted in August 2024, so the original repo path no longer resolves. Verify the mirror's files and licence at download time; do not assume the mirror is identical without checking its commit hash.
chosen.base_model_revision: Resolved at generation time by generate.py via HfApi().model_info().sha and written into outputs/raw/<id>.json and outputs/models.json — never left as FILL-IN.
chosen.lora_license: NOT STATED in the fetched model card (checked 2026-10-28). Verify the repo's licence/metadata before commercial redistribution; do not assume a licence.
chosen.lora_revision: Resolved at generation time by generate.py via HfApi().model_info().sha and written into outputs/raw/<id>.json and outputs/models.json — never left as FILL-IN.
chosen.rejected_for_this_project: thliang01/pixel-art-sdxl-dora-v0-9 — SDXL DoRA, not SD 1.5 compatible; attaching it to an SD 1.5 base would be an architecture mismatch
chosen.trade_off_note: SD 1.5 + Varo pixel-art LoRA was kept after verification: it is the only verified SD 1.5-compatible LoRA found with a documented Diffusers example and trigger; SDXL alternatives (e.g. thliang01/pixel-art-sdxl-dora-v0-9) would need more VRAM and are architecture-incompatible with SD 1.5, and the distilled bk-sdm-tiny model trades away most detail for CPU feasibility. Trade-off: SD 1.5 gives consistent 512px game art on 6 GB VRAM, but its LoRA licence is unverified — verify before commercial redistribution, or swap to a licenced LoRA with the same base.

cpu_fallback_considered_not_used_here.why_not_used_in_vm: Even this distilled model is documented as needing ~8 GB RAM + 12 CPU cores for slow CPU generation, and 16-32 GB RAM and/or a GPU for practical speed. The Muse VM has 2 cores and ~3.6 GB RAM available, so a CPU test was judged impractical and was not started (no weights downloaded).

inference_settings_for_6gb_vram.download_size_estimate: ~4.27 GB for the SD 1.5 ema-only fp16 weights (per the original model card), plus the LoRA file (confirm its size on the repo Files tab at download time)
inference_settings_for_6gb_vram.offload_note: Enable sequential CPU offload ONLY if a 6 GB run OOMs; it is much slower.
inference_settings_for_6gb_vram.safety_checker: disabled only for local game-asset generation of non-sensitive content; keep it enabled if the workflow is ever shared

weights_location: Hugging Face cache only (HF_HOME). NEVER in public/, never in git, never in the Vercel deployment.
